Container.Name: plex-mcp-server
Container.Overview: MCP (Model Context Protocol) server for Plex Media Server. Exposes library browsing, content discovery, watch history, and recommendations over Streamable HTTP so AI assistants (Claude, etc.) can interact with your Plex library. Designed to sit behind mcp-edge-gateway for authentication.

Config.Name: MCP HTTP Port
Config.Description: Host port for the MCP server. Use this in your mcp-edge-gateway upstream URL.

Config.Name: Plex URL
Config.Description: Base URL of your Plex Media Server, including protocol and port.

Config.Name: Plex Token
Config.Description: Plex authentication token. Optional when mcp-edge-gateway is configured to inject the X-Plex-Token header (recommended). Required for direct deployments without the gateway.

Config.Name: Plex Client ID
Config.Description: Stable UUID sent as X-Plex-Client-Identifier. Auto-generated each startup if not set.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: Log verbosity: trace, debug, info, warn, error. Use info in production.
